wrong.sentence: In 2025 warehouse headcount grew by 7%.
wrong.why: The Documents give a 7% rise in freight volumes in 2025, not a 7% rise in warehouse headcount.

wrong.sentence: Harbourline owned 1,840 trailers at the end of 2025.
wrong.why: The Document gives 1,840 drivers at the end of 2025, not trailers.

wrong.sentence: Insurance cost Harbourline £14.2m in 2025.
wrong.why: The Document gives £14.2m as Harbourline's fuel costs for 2025, not insurance cost.

wrong.sentence: Late deliveries fell 18% from 2024.
wrong.why: The Document gives an 18% fall only for customer complaints, not late deliveries.

wrong.sentence: Customers took 2.4 days on average to pay their invoices in 2025.
Rail partners carried Harbourline's freight 96 million kilometres in 2025.
wrong.why: The 96 million kilometres in the Document refers to the company's own fleet, not rail partners carrying freight.

wrong.sentence: Water use per tonne fell 11% in 2025.
Earnings were 6.5p per share.
wrong.why: The Document gives a final dividend of 6.5p per share, not earnings per share, so the Documents do not establish that earnings were 6.5p per share.

wrong.sentence: Free cash flow came to £38m in 2025.
wrong.why: The Documents give £38m only as capital expenditure in 2025, not as free cash flow.

wrong.sentence: Felixstowe depot's space occupancy was 94% in 2025.
wrong.why: The Documents give Felixstowe's on-time rate as 94%, not space occupancy.

right.sentence: Harbourline employed 1,840 drivers at the end of 2025.
An average delivery took 2.4 days in 2025.
The fleet covered 96 million kilometres in 2025.
Carbon emissions per tonne fell 11% in 2025.
The final dividend is 6.5p per share.
